name: # Names a text is cited by that are not its title, for the model's citations
# (db/model/*.jsonl). The resolver reads this after number, date and title; it
# applies only when the text is not dated after the citing text, so a name
# that meant an earlier text in an earlier time is left unresolved.
# Only names that fit one text in our data are listed, each checked against
# the titles and article counts. The ones that do not (قانون الانتخاب,
# قانون الجزاء, تعريفة الجمارك, الاصول المدنية, قانون الاسكان, قانون الاثار)
# are left out on purpose: each fits several texts, or none we hold.
# name is matched as the resolver folds titles: hamza, ta marbuta, a leading
قانون الجمعيات
note: the 1909 law; 19 articles; cited from 1926 on, articles up to 14

name: قانون الاتصالات
note: law 431/2002; 53 articles; cited 2005 to 2009, articles up to 48

name: قانون ضريبة الاملاك المبنية
note: law of 17 Sep 1962; a 1974 decree title names it so

name: قانون رسم الانتقال
note: decree-law 146/1959; a 2017 law title names it so

name: قانون الملكية
note: decision 3339/1930; laws 322/2001 and 47/1971 call it "قانون الملكية العقارية"

name: قانون الموظفين
note: decree-law 112/1959; a 1967 law title names it so; texts before 1959 stay unresolved

name: قانون العقوبات العام
